english.title: Sell plate / device which is not a vehicle registration plate because registration mark fails to comply with regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold a plate or other device which was not a vehicle registration plate only because the registration mark

(A)_[displayed by it did not comply with **(..SPECIFY THE REGULATIONS..) made under section 15(4)(b) of the Haulage Permits and Trailer Registration Act 2018]_
(B)_[is displayed otherwise than in accordance with **(..SPECIFY THE REGULATIONS..) made under section 15(4)(c) and (d)(i) of the Haulage Permits and Trailer Registration Act 2018]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28(1A) and (3) of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001.

english.notes:
(i) This offence relates to vehicle registration plates; in relation to trailer registration plates, see offence wording document H19567.
(ii) Proceedings under this section instituted by a person or body other than a local authority or a constable must have the permission of the Attorney General.
(iii) See section 17(2) for clarification of "carries on business as a registration plate supplier".
(iv) "Registered" means registered in accordance with the provisions of Part 2 of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001 in a register established and maintained by the Secretary of State.
(v) See section 31(1) for other interpretations of Part 2 of the Act.
(vi) See section 27(5) for defence.
(vii) See section 20(2) for alternative/additional penalty.
(viii) This offence was inserted by the Road Safety Act 2006

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note
Where a registered person is convicted of this offence the court may, instead of or in addition to imposing a fine, by order suspend his registration for any period of up to five years (section 20(2)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
